blog.title: How to prepare for your visa application
blog.author: Disha Overseas
blog.excerpt: A few simple habits make visa applications faster and calmer. Here is where to begin.
blog.content:
A good visa application starts well before you fill in any form. These simple steps help most applicants.

## Check your passport first

Make sure your passport has enough validity and blank pages for your trip. If it is close to expiring, renew it before you apply.

## Decide your travel plan

Know your dates, cities and purpose of travel. Authorities want to see a clear and genuine plan.

## Collect documents early

- Passport and photographs
- Travel and stay details
- Financial documents
- Any invitation or supporting letters

## Apply with time to spare

Start several weeks before travel. Rushed applications are more likely to have mistakes.

If you would like help, our team is happy to review your documents.

blog.title: Tourist visa or business visa: which one do you need?
blog.author: Disha Overseas
blog.excerpt: The purpose of your trip decides your visa type. Choosing wrongly can cause delay or refusal.
blog.content:
Choosing the correct visa category is the first step of any application.

## Tourist visa

For holidays, sightseeing, and visiting friends or family. You will not be doing paid work or business there.

## Business visa

For meetings, conferences, trade talks and other business activities. It usually needs supporting documents such as an invitation from a company.

## Not sure?

Tell us about your trip and we will recommend the right category before you apply.
